pages.choiceQuality: No answer-choice set is used here; the page's value comes from reading, retrieval, role-play, or conversation.
pages.componentConsistency: The page presents one visible learner job using the approved shared component vocabulary.
pages.notes: Root reviewed the exact source and rendered every page at 360px and 480px; representative high-risk pages were also inspected directly in Orca.
